QUOTE: The part before the first `:` is matched against the tool name. If there is a colon, the whole string is matched against `tool:<argvalue>`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, splitting at the first colon into a tool part and an argument part, and that a pattern with no colon matches on the tool name alone ("no colon means tool-only match").
